# J Illusion Beauty Salon

> Family salon & barbería based in Round Rock, Texas. A bilingual family salon and barbería in Round Rock: fades and kids' cuts, beard design, color and highlights, braids, makeup and nails, all under one roof. Walk-ins welcome. Se habla español.

- Phone: (512) 394-5393
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Hutto, Georgetown, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 4.3 from 67 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/j-illusion-beauty-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/j-illusion-beauty-salon/book.html

## Services
- Cortes para toda la familia: Haircuts and fades for men, women and kids, from a first haircut to a clean skin fade.
- Diseño de barba: Beard design, shaping and line-ups, plus freehand razor designs on fades.
- Color: All-over color, from rich reds to soft silver and blonde.
- Rayitos y transparencias: Highlights and lightening (iluminaciones) for bright, dimensional hair.
- Peinados, trenzas y maquillaje: Styles, braids, perms and makeup for school days, quinces, weddings and nights out.
- Uñas y depilación: Manicures, pedicures, acrylic nails and waxing while you're already here.

## About
J Illusion Beauty Salon opened in August 2021 in Suite 100 at 2013 N Mays St in Round Rock. Everything we do is painted right on our window, in Spanish: cortes para toda la familia, diseño de barba, color, rayitos, permanentes, peinados, trenzas, maquillaje, depilación, manicure, pedicure y uñas acrílicas. Our team speaks Spanish and English, so the whole family can explain exactly what they want. Walk in, have a seat, grab a snack from our stand, and we'll take care of you.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk in any day we're open and we'll fit you in, or call (512) 394-5393 to set up a time for color, braids or makeup.
- Q: ¿Hablan español?
  A: Sí. Our team speaks Spanish and English, so you can explain your cut or color however you like.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes, kids are some of our favorite clients, from first haircuts to school-day braids and fades.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 10 AM to 7 PM, and Sunday 10 AM to 3 PM.
- Q: Where are you and is there parking?
  A: Suite 100 at 2013 N Mays St in Round Rock, with plenty of parking right out front.
- Q: Do you do hair designs on fades?
  A: Yes. Razor designs, line-ups and zigzag napes for kids and grown-ups. See recent ones in our gallery.
